severalThreads: {count} threads start with {ref}; give more of the id
otherVersion: the host answered {op} in a shape this wsp does not read; it runs another version of wsp, restart it with wsp up
gone: {name}'s machine is gone with its disk, so work that was not pushed is lost; rebuild it to {action}, which brings back its home folder from the last saved nap
goneWith: {name}'s machine is gone with its disk, so work that was not pushed is lost; rebuild it to {action}, which brings back its home folder from the last saved nap ({words})

stopped.not-found: thread {thread} not found by the host

stopUnderOne: , and with it 1 thread its agents spawned: {under}
stopUnderSome: , and with it {count} threads its agents spawned: {under}

renamed.unsupported: thread {thread} not named: {agent} keeps no name of a person's for a session
renamed.no-session: thread {thread} not named: {agent} on the machine has no such session
renamed.not-found: thread {thread} not found by the host

renameFailedSilent: thread {thread} not named: the machine said nothing about the write
threadWithoutId: {row} is a turn from before threads and carries no thread id of its own; no forget can name it
threadForgot: forgot thread {thread}: no turn ever ran on it, so nothing of its work is gone
noOpenAsk: thread {thread} is waiting on no prompt; wsp threads says which threads need you

answerRoads.noSuchAnswer: the prompt thread {thread} is stopped on takes no allow; wsp thread read shows what it asks
the prompt thread {thread} is stopped on takes no deny; wsp thread read shows what it asks

answerWords.gone: the prompt closed before the answer reached it
answerWords.unsupported: this thread's agent raises no prompt this host can answer
answerWords.not-found: this host holds no turn of that thread
answerWords.no-option: the prompt carries no option by that id

restarted.none: the host restarted and serves again; no thread is running on it
restarted.one: the host restarted and serves again; 1 thread is still running on it: {ids}
restarted.some: the host restarted and serves again; {count} threads are still running on it: {ids}

hostDidNotStop: the host took the restart and was still serving after 20s
cwdNotAbsolute: --cwd is a path on the machine, absolute, and got "{path}". Give a path that opens with /, since whoever reads it works in a folder this line cannot see.
emptyTask: the task is empty; say what the thread is to do. Put it in quotes after the flags.
noAdapter: no adapter registered for harness "{agent}"; agents on this host: {agents}. Name one of those with --agent.
noAdapterNone: no adapter registered for harness "{agent}"; agents on this host: none. Name one of those with --agent.

notOne.model: model "{value}" is not one {subject} takes; one of: {options}
notOne.effort: effort "{value}" is not one {subject} takes; one of: {options}
notOne.access: access mode "{value}" is not one {subject} takes; one of: {options}

picks.noFast: {model} has no fast mode; pick a model that offers it, or send without it
picks.refused: {said}. Drop the flag, or give it a value the agent offers.
picks.builtInList: ; that list is wsp's built-in one, since no agent on that workspace described itself, and the agent on its machine may take more
picks.builtInTable: ; wsp's built-in table says so, since no agent on that workspace described itself

noThreadTarget: workspace is needed outside a repo: run from inside a repo one of the workspaces holds, or name the workspace. Run wsp workspaces to read the names.
guestNamesWorkspace: a line from a workspace names the workspace it means, since the folder it was typed in is not one this host can read. Name the workspace on the line.
noWorkspaceForFolder: no workspace holds a project for {folder}; name one with workspace, or wsp add '{folder}' records it as a project here
noThreadStamped: the runtime stamped no thread on the session

files.notAFile: there is no file at {path} on this computer. Name a file that is already here.
files.guest: a path on this line would be read on the person's computer, not on the machine the line was typed on. Name a file on the machine the line runs on, or none.
files.refused: {refusal}. Drop that one and send the rest.
files.tooMany: only 5 files fit one message; this one carries {count}
files.imageTooBig: {name} is {size}, over the 10 MB an image may be
files.fileTooBig: {name} is {size}, over the 10 MB a file may be

recipe.outNotAbsolute: out is a path on this computer, absolute, and got "{path}". Give a path that opens with /, since whoever reads it works in a folder this line cannot see.
recipe.projectNotAbsolute: project is a folder on this computer, absolute, and got "{path}". Give a path that opens with /, since whoever reads it works in a folder this line cannot see.
recipe.floorLine: on when used in 2 sessions and 5 commands; heavy rows 3 and 20
recipe.commandsTitle: Commands your agents ran that the catalog does not carry:
